QUOTE: The reason string records that the whole repo was used and why, and it is logged. This matters because a declaration that exists but yields no roots must not be reported as "none declared."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states the whole-repo fallback carries a reason string recording which scope was used and why, and that a rejected declaration must not be reported as "none declared," so an unstated scope is never silently assumed.
